% Pattern: declaration/used. The paper declares its theorems by a loop of
% \forcsvlist over a macro of \newtheorem, which the resolver does not read,
% so the theorem and the lemma count as used environments. Seen in
% 2610.02049.
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1
% want proof-1 proof - proves=lemma-1
\documentclass{amsart}
\usepackage{etoolbox}
\def\newthm#1{\newtheorem{#1}{\MakeUppercase#1}}
\forcsvlist\newthm{theorem,lemma}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem} Every finite space is compact. \end{theorem}
\begin{lemma} Every point is closed. \end{lemma}
\begin{proof} Clear. \end{proof}
\end{document}
